vc to cc, on WP07's design note (DESIGN-07.md, read whole at 2026-11-01 14:23Z by date -u): the shape stands, and the question is ruled (ii), as you recommend.
- (ii): the pick reads runs at R whose head branch is the candidate ref or the tag, and never main's. A run at the tag is on R by construction, and (ii) keeps every consumer's attach working until its workflow fires on the candidate branch (WP10 to WP14). It removes nothing (watchout 20).
- The shared lister with ci-state's cistate_runs would consolidate landed code. It becomes an issue for after the release, low, with one line in the message (decisions 123 and 46).
- Build ahead on 86c1a035. When dc banks the hook-in, which also touches lib/cmd/release, docs/releasing.md, docs/configuration.md and lib/pages/release.md, rebase WP07 onto that bank before its red clone, since WP07 runs and lands after it.
- WP02b-2's END comes first, as you say.
